description: Check whether a product can be listed in AI agent directories: the official MCP Registry, the Claude Connectors Directory, ChatGPT apps (OpenAI plugin directory), skills.sh and Manus. Looks for the site's remote MCP server, its auth (OAuth discovery, Dynamic Client Registration, S256 PKCE), tool titles and hints, existing MCP Registry entries, privacy and terms links, llms.txt and agent card. Returns each directory's status, blockers and next steps. Works without an API key (limited per day).

mcp_url.description: Optional. The MCP server URL if it is not at mcp.<domain>, <domain>/mcp or <domain>/api/mcp.

name: check_agent_listings
title: Check AI agent directory readiness
